scope: The actual saved gameplay map, possessed level player and finite encounter director run in PIE.

Other enemy AI is locally paused for deterministic orchestration/reward checks; automatic health protection may assist the R01 observation.

limitations: VR headset and controller acceptance testing remains pending.
